contract.initial: Reuse original student S1 output after C restoration and before GEO
contract.steps: S2..S5 each from previous restored output; N unchanged; known first K
contract.scaling: FP32 model coordinate * fixed SCALE .95*.3762 before each call; FP32 divide after each call
contract.proposal: effective_proposal already adds the residual once; do not add input again
contract.C: Overwrite C from original RAW bytes after each proposal; retain restored full mesh for next input
contract.terminal_GEO: Once at S3/S5, identical frozen GEO_C
contract.model_mode: FP32 parameters / BF16 forward / eval / zero dropout / math SDPA

hazards: Do not feed S1 POST mesh; GEO would change N/geometry and recurrence
Do not feed unconstrained S1 proposal or previous proposal_d; C must be restored first
Do not keep continuous denoiser-domain values across rounds; old official contract includes model-domain FP32 round trips
single_student_proposal displacement_from_RAW is relative to supplied input_model; in rounds2..5 this is previous output, so rename or separately calculate true original-RAW displacement
Preserve S1 checkpoint/output/receipt hashes and exact registered RAW pairing
On a started model call with no closed receipt, stop rather than silently replay
Do not interpret repeated-denoising mesh gains as improved original single-step teacher-fidelity without a separate defined comparison
